item.title: Notify NYC - MTA Disruption - A, C, & E Train Service
item.description:
Notification issued 11-02-2026 at 11:25 AM.
Due to a signal problem, expect delays & service changes in both directions on A, C, and E train service in Manhattan. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
For more information, please visit www.mta.info.
